caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bust of a human figure, shown from the chest upward, rendered in a naturalistic brown wood color with visible grain and texture. The figure has a solemn face with detailed features such as deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and parted lips. The hair is styled back, and the ears are visible, one adorned with a small round earring. The figure is wearing a high-collared, ruffled garment, with ornate, curved details at the chest and shoulders. Behind the head is a large, fan-shaped halo that radiates outward with evenly spaced, carved ridges. The wood grain and varying shades of brown are used to give the appearance of depth and texture throughout the bust. The drawing is set against a blank, off-white background, with the signature "Alvin M. Gaily - 1939" written below the bust.
title: Head from Circus Wagon
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
